Market today: The mood is sour for tech and chips. A Nasdaq sell-off is battering chip stocks, and growing AI debt concerns around data centers are adding pressure. A rethink on interest rates after a Democrat sweep could also hit growth names like yours.

Your holdings: SOXL (-81.82%), MUU (-66.07%), and SMH (-29.64%) are bleeding heavily. Your leveraged positions are amplifying these drops, especially on margin, and their stops are ineffective.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any further news regarding AI data center financing and the broader Nasdaq performance. The scanner shows strength in inverse chip/Nasdaq plays.

Bottom line: Focus on aggressive risk management for your deeply underwater leveraged chip positions.
plays: Address the broken stops on SOXL, MUU, SPAL. These leveraged positions are bleeding heavily; consider trimming or exiting to manage risk.
Given the chip sector weakness, SOXS (inverse semiconductors) shows a strong scanner setup. Consider a small hedge at entry 77.67-77.17 with stop 74.07.
